$comment: Generated from rights.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to rights.yaml>`. Do not edit.

AccessOption.description: One access level the researcher could set, and when it applies.

level.description: The access level, one of open, embargoed, restricted or closed.

when.description: When this access level applies, as a fixed sentence.

AccessOption.title: AccessOption

GroundingRef.description: The identity and content hash of one retrieved thing a payload rests on. The only way a payload may name an external resource as a decided identity, and the only place it names it: what the reference identifies is read from the evidence item with the same source_id and content_hash (docs/specs/grounding.md). The linter matches every GroundingRef against a retrieval span on both fields.
GroundingRef.title: GroundingRef

LicenceOption.description: One licence the researcher could choose, always from the adviser's own table. A model may choose which of the table's licences fit the reuse wanted and their order, never add one.

url.description: Where the licence text is published.

note.description: What the researcher should know about this licence, if anything.

derivation.description: How the value came about: template, by the adviser's rules (a keyword in the reuse wanted, a mandate, the fixed questions), or model, where a model read the reuse wanted or added a question.

LicenceOption.title: LicenceOption

RightsQuestion.description: One thing the researcher must answer or confirm first, from the adviser's template or added by a model.

text.description: The question, as put to the researcher.

derivation.description: How the value came about: template, by the adviser's rules (a keyword in the reuse wanted, a mandate, the fixed questions), or model, where a model read the reuse wanted or added a question.

RightsQuestion.title: RightsQuestion

description: The payload of advisor.rights: licences and access levels for the researcher to choose from, and the questions to answer first. It lists options and never chooses one.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

questions.description: What the researcher must answer or confirm, with the people who can help.

limitations.description: What this adviser does not yet do.

dropped.description: What the model replied that was not used, and why: a reuse it named that the table does not know, a licence not among those that fit, or a question it may not ask.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

title: RightsOptions
